title: Speed benchmark: large 10-story building
purpose: A large floor plate: 10 x 6 bays of 25 ft (250 x 150 ft), 10 stories of 13 ft, 8 in slabs as thin shells meshed at 5 ft (15,000 shell elements, beams split at every slab node, about 95,000 equations). Linear only: self-weight, superimposed load, lateral load and 12 modes, timed in both programs on the same PC, ETABS on its advanced solver with all cores.

settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.diaphragm: none: slabs in-plane stiff by their own shells
settings.solver: ETABS advanced solver, all cores; SkyFrame default (PARDISO when installed)
